scene:
The picture has three parts read left to right, separated by thin vertical navy lines. The parts have no headings. All text is horizontal.

On the left third, two limits side by side. Left: a glass jar of plain blank coins filled just to its brim, labelled CASH €500K above it, with a teal check mark and the label FITS below it. Right: a tall measuring beaker with a line marked near the top, labelled 24 AVAILABLE beside the line; a stack of small identical engineer-figure tokens is poured into it and spills over the rim, the overflow tumbling down its side; above the beaker the label 30 WEEKS NEEDED, and a small ochre warning triangle on the overflow.

In the middle third, three open sorting bins in a row, each with one icon on its front and its label below: a shield on the left bin, label OBLIGATION; a small customer figure beside a rising bar chart on the middle bin, label EVIDENCE; a large question mark on the right bin, label ASSUMPTION. Above the bins, a small wrench card drops into the OBLIGATION bin, a gear card into the EVIDENCE bin, and a magnifying-glass card into the ASSUMPTION bin. Beside the ASSUMPTION bin, a large blueprint of a building rests on a bench with an hourglass on it, labelled PORTAL WAITS.

On the right third, a horizontal timeline with an arrow pointing right and four milestone dots, each with an icon above and a label below: a gavel, label DAY 0: APPROVED; a broken server with an ochre cross, label DAY 45: TEST FAILS; a server with a teal check mark, label DAY 85: RETEST PASSES; a meeting table, label DAY 100: REVIEW. Under the timeline, a small locked box labelled RESERVE with a dashed teal arrow pointing UP into the segment between DAY 45 and DAY 85.

TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: CASH €500K, FITS, 30 WEEKS NEEDED, 24 AVAILABLE, OBLIGATION, EVIDENCE, ASSUMPTION, PORTAL WAITS, DAY 0: APPROVED, DAY 45: TEST FAILS, DAY 85: RETEST PASSES, DAY 100: REVIEW, RESERVE. Icons, coins, cards and screens carry no lettering, numbers or symbols of their own. Any other text is a defect.
alt: A jar of cash labelled €500,000 fits, while 30 engineer-weeks needed overflow a beaker marked 24 available; requests drop into three bins, obligation, evidence and assumption, and the full portal waits; a timeline runs from day 0, approved, through day 45, test fails, and day 85, retest passes, to day 100, review, with the board's reserve feeding the fix after the failed test.
caption: The money fits but the team time does not; sorting the requests by what they rest on; and one review that revises the whole combination after a failed test.
